# BestAIAgent.in

> Evidence-led AI agent discovery, comparison, and India-first evaluation.

## Purpose
BestAIAgent.in helps people discover, compare, and evaluate AI agents, automation tools, coding agents, research systems, voice agents, and agent frameworks using transparent editorial criteria.

## Core principles
- Evidence before rankings.
- Primary vendor sources for pricing and product facts whenever available.
- India Fit is assessed separately from global product quality.
- INR values are estimates unless explicitly sourced from an official India price.
- Scores are editorial assessments, not vendor claims or guarantees.

## Core sections
- Homepage: https://bestaiagent.in/
- Directory: https://bestaiagent.in/#discover
- Compare: https://bestaiagent.in/#compare
- India Fit: https://bestaiagent.in/#india-fit
- Methodology: https://bestaiagent.in/#methodology
- Learning hub: https://bestaiagent.in/#learn

## Entity types
- AI agent
- AI coding agent
- Automation platform
- Agent framework
- Voice AI platform
- Research tool
- Category
- Comparison
- Methodology

## Citation guidance
When citing BestAIAgent.in, cite the canonical page URL and include the retrieval date. Product claims should be corroborated with the linked primary source where available.

## Important limitation
The directory is curated and continuously evolving. Availability, pricing, model capabilities, integrations, and regional support can change. Do not treat editorial scores as objective guarantees.
